title: Key role of PPAR-gamma-mediated suppression of the NFkappaB signaling pathway in rutin's antidepressant effect.
authors: Yin, Shu-Yuan; Shao, Xin-Xin; Shen, Shi-Yu; Zhang, Jia-Rui; Shen, Zu-Qi; Liang, Ling-Feng; Chen, Cong; Yue, Na; Fu, Xian-Jun; Yu, Jin
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芦丁通过PPAR-gamma抑制NFkappaB通路发挥抗抑郁作用，虽用分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Depression is a chronic and recurrent disorder with an unknown etiology. Efficacious antidepressant treatments with minimal side effects are urgently needed. Neuroinflammation may contribute to depression, as anti-inflammatory drugs have been shown to alleviate depressive symptoms in clinical practice. Rutin, a naturally occurring flavonoid derived from plants, is abundant in many antidepressant herbs, including Hemerocallis citrina Baroni. Historical Chinese medical texts, including the renowned Compendium of Materia Medica, document H. citrina Baroni as possessing antidepressant properties. Rutin, one of its primary active constituents, is recognized for its anti-inflammatory effects. Despite this, little is known about its specific target and mechanism. METHODS: In the present study, molecular docking, and surface plasmon resonance imaging (SPRi) analysis were used to identify the special targets of rutin. Meanwhile, the potential antidepressant effects were evaluated in the chronic social defeat stress (CSDS) paradigm, an animal model of depression. Then, Western blotting, quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR), Co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) as well as antagonists of PPAR-gamma were utilized to investigate the mechanism underlying the antidepressant effect of rutin. RESULTS: Both molecular docking and SPRi analysis showed high docking scores and interactions between rutin and PPAR-gamma. In vivo, rutin promoted the nuclear translocation of PPAR-gamma in the hippocampus of mice, inhibited NFkappaB-mediated inflammatory pathways, and subsequently reduced the expression of pro-inflammatory factors (e.g., iNOS, IL-6), aligning with an antidepressant effect. However, this therapeutic effect was attenuated by GW9662, a specific antagonist of PPAR-gamma. CONCLUSION: As a result of activating PPAR-gamma and inhibiting NFkappaB pathway activation, rutin reduces neuroinflammation and exhibits an antidepressant effect. These findings shed light on the antidepressant mechanism of rutin and could be valuable for the development of new antidepressants.
abstract_zh: 背景：抑郁症是一种病因不明的慢性复发性疾病，亟需疗效显著且副作用最小的抗抑郁治疗。神经炎症可能与抑郁症相关，临床实践中已证明抗炎药物能缓解抑郁症状。芦丁（rutin）是一种天然存在的植物来源类黄酮，富含于多种抗抑郁草药中，包括黄花菜（Hemerocallis citrina Baroni）。包括著名《本草纲目》在内的中医典籍记载，黄花菜具有抗抑郁特性。芦丁作为其主要活性成分之一，以其抗炎作用而闻名。尽管如此，其具体靶点和机制尚不明确。方法：本研究采用分子对接 (molecular docking) 和表面等离子体共振成像 (surface plasmon resonance imaging, SPRi) 分析来识别芦丁的特异性靶点。同时，在慢性社交挫败应激 (chronic social defeat stress, CSDS) 范式（一种抑郁症动物模型）中评估其潜在抗抑郁效果。随后，利用蛋白质印迹法 (Western blotting)、定量实时聚合酶链反应 (quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, qRT-PCR)、免疫共沉淀 (Co-immunoprecipitation, Co-IP) 以及PPAR-γ拮抗剂来探究芦丁抗抑郁作用的机制。结果：分子对接和SPRi分析均显示芦丁与PPAR-γ之间具有高对接评分和相互作用。在体内，芦丁促进小鼠海马中PPAR-γ的核转位，抑制NFkappaB介导的炎症通路，并随后降低促炎因子（如iNOS、IL-6）的表达，这与抗抑郁效果一致。然而，这种治疗效果被PPAR-γ特异性拮抗剂GW9662所减弱。结论：通过激活PPAR-γ并抑制NFkappaB通路激活，芦丁减少神经炎症并表现出抗抑郁作用。这些发现揭示了芦丁的抗抑郁机制，可能对新抗抑郁药的开发具有重要价值。
